summary: A self proclaimed crypto guru on X directed the victim to a Telegram trading bot that displayed fabricated profits and repeatedly demanded larger deposits to avoid liquidation and unlock withdrawals. The portfolio balance and trading activity were fake and the deposited funds were controlled by the scammers.
user_mistake: Trusted unrealistic investment claims and deposited funds into an unverified Telegram trading bot
prevention: Reject investment offers promising extraordinary returns / Verify trading platforms through independent trusted sources before depositing funds
